CustomField.description: Programme chosen for this student in the "Sync Leads to Salesforce" popup (departments other than Undergraduation). Written to a new Lead's Preferred Programme and filled on an existing Lead only when blank. Must be an active Lead.Preferred_Programme__c value; validated by ZoomLeadSyncController. Text, not picklist, so the Lead programme list is the only list to maintain.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set through the Sync Leads to Salesforce button on the Zoom Session.
CustomField.label: Preferred Programme
